name: Hurting Another Person
overview: Scripture teaches that how we speak and treat others profoundly affects relationships and reflects our obedience to Christ. Proverbs 15:1 highlights the power of gentle words to defuse anger, contrasting them with harsh speech that provokes strife. Jesus commands believers to love one another as He has loved us (John 13:34), setting the highest standard for interpersonal conduct. Ephesians 4:32 urges kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness, modeling God's grace through Christ as the foundation for healing and restoring those we may have hurt.
